SH Beckwith  Washn Aug 4th 1864
Viola Andrew for Magic Had you asked my opinion
in regard to Meriden & Negus it would have
been freely & frankly given but I must beg
toby excused from deciding questions which lawfully & properly 
belong to your office stop I can give no
instructions to either till you decide upon their prospects
tulip I await your repeats & shall strictly carry
them out what ever they may be Welch Embrace
